full_page.content:
1954, September 4 1957, February 11
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of handwritten messages written on Seraphic Mass Association card and holy pictures by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
(to Mr. Phil L'Esperance ) St. Felix, Huntington, Ind. Poor Holy Souls in Purgatory Sept. 4th, 1954 Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Pleased be God.
2/11/57 Appearance of Mary Immac. Queen and Mother of Missionaries and of Promoters of the Missions Pray for our missions and appreciation of our Christ-like work and Privileges ! !
Congratulations Dear Friends on the grace of your perseverance. God bless you and all yours.
Capuchin Fathers and Missionaries
% Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Bles'd be Jesus! Now and forever!
Glory be to God! Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Originals in possession of: Mr. Phil L'Esperance 19820 Jerome St. Apt. #223 Roseville, MI. 48066
